description: May 31 birthday meaning: Gemini decan 1, birthday number 4, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a May 31 birthday falls in Gemini, in the first decan, with Mercury as the sign's ruler and Mercury as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 4. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Gemini is mutable and air.

sections.heading: May 31 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: May's last day gives Gemini something it often lacks: the steady number 4. Nine degrees into the Twins, at the close of the Mercury decan, this birthday is often read as organised curiosity, someone who keeps notes, builds systems and turns scattered interests into a working method. Lists, spreadsheets and well-labelled folders may be their quiet love language.

On May 31 the Sun usually sits at about 9° Gemini, in the first decan, where Mercury rules the decan as well as the sign. Doubled Mercury makes the first ten degrees of Gemini, roughly May 21 to May 31, the most quicksilver part of an already lively sign. Curiosity is the engine here: questions, conversations, books opened at the middle, two projects running at once. Traditional descriptions stress wit, verbal agility and a talent for translating between people who would not otherwise understand each other. The same speed can make boredom arrive early and commitments feel like cages. For anyone born in this decan, depth often comes not from slowing down overall but from choosing one or two threads to follow all the way through.

sections.heading: May 31 in numerology
paragraphs: Born on the 31st, your compound is 3 + 1 = 4. The 3 brings creativity and the 1 brings drive, and the 4 that results gives them a practical shape. People born on this day are often described as builders with imagination, able to design a plan and then see it through with steady effort. They tend to value loyalty and long-term commitment. In its supporting role, the 31 is traditionally associated with organising creative ideas into something lasting. Leaving room for spontaneity helps, since structure can harden into routine if nothing new is let in.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one May 31 birthday to the next: it is 7 for 1960, 8 for 1970, 9 for 1980 and 1 for 1990, for example. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11.

sections.heading: Born on May 31: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: May brings late spring in the northern hemisphere, a season of blossom and long evenings, and late autumn to the southern. Taurus holds the first three weeks, with Gemini arriving around May 20 or 21. In numerology May is month 5, the number of freedom, curiosity and change, which tends to give these birthdays a restless, experimental streak beneath the calm Taurean surface. May 31 is the 151st day of the year (152nd in a leap year). By June 22, 22 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Cancer.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by May 31, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on May 31 include Walt Whitman (1819), Clint Eastwood (1930) and Svetlana Alexievich (1948).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is May 31?
faq.answer: May 31 is Gemini in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the first decan of Gemini, which tradition links with Mercury.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on May 31?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On May 31 the Life Path is 7 in 1960, 8 in 1970, 9 in 1980, 1 in 1990, 11 in 2000, 3 in 2010 and 4 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 4 for everyone born on the 31st.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on May 31?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for a May 31 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on May 31?
faq.answer: May 31 is also the birthday of Walt Whitman (1819), Clint Eastwood (1930) and Svetlana Alexievich (1948). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
